# bitbucket_user (Data Source)

Looks up a Bitbucket Cloud user, so you can resolve their UUID for use in other resources (e.g. bitbucket_branch_restriction's users, or bitbucket_repository_user_permission's user) instead of hardcoding it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "bitbucket_user" "jcardenas" {
  selected_user = "jcardenas"
}

resource "bitbucket_default_reviewer" "lead" {
  repository_slug = bitbucket_repository.api.slug
  user            = data.bitbucket_user.jcardenas.uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `selected_user` (String) UUID, username or Atlassian account ID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Atlassian account ID of the user.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the user.
- `id` (String) Identifier (the user's UUID).
- `nickname` (String) Nickname of the user.
- `username` (String) Username, if the account still has one (new accounts are identified by account_id instead).
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the user.
